snippet.title: MINESWEEPER PLUS - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Download here: https://jorel-simpson.itch.io/minesweeper-plus

My recording software didn't pick up my mouse movements, so pretend there is a cursor flying around the screen. And sorry if the audio is a little warbly. It sounds better in-game.

If I'm going to be the Minesweeper guy, then I need to prove I have what it takes to be the Minesweeper guy. I used to look at a Minesweeper grid and think to myself, "what the heck do all these numbers mean"? Now I have a perfect understanding of how the game is played, and to prove I know, I developed my own version of Minesweeper: MINESWEEPER PLUS.

I didn't choose the Minesweeper life. The Minesweeper life chose me.

Thanks for all your support.
